groups.title: Precincts
groups.note: Precinct committeemen and committeewomen elected at the latest primary, from the official Campbell County primary results. Precincts with no named winner (write-in only) are not listed.

groups.title: Municipal offices
groups.note: The City of Gillette and the Town of Wright appear on the official Campbell County November general ballot. No Gillette Ward 2 contest appears on the official 2024 general, so the second Ward 2 seat whose ordinary term ended January 2025 is not named. Doug Schrader holds a 2024 Wright council term but takes office as mayor in January 2027; a replacement for the remainder of that council term is not named on the official 2026 general.

groups.title: School boards
groups.note: Campbell County School District. Three trustees were elected in 2022 (terms end January 2027) and three in 2026. Four trustees were elected in 2020 to terms that ended January 2025; no school-board contest appears on the official 2024 general summary, so later holders of those seats are not named.

groups.title: Special districts
groups.note: The official 2026 Conservation District rural and at-large contests were write-in only and the official write-in canvass does not certify a named winner (the leading line on both is “NO NAME PROVIDED”). Those two seats, currently held by John Daly (rural) and Kim Kretschman (at-large) through January 2027, are therefore shown without a named successor. The official 2024 Conservation District vote-for-2 contest is not labeled rural, urban, or at-large. The official 2022 Cemetery District vote-for-1 contest (J.D. Jones) does not say unexpired; that term length is uncertain.
